data.name: 59_1_F3.175T1F1.5T3F1T4V3.175T6E0.3T7
data.description: Set up a fixture plate larger than the blank (100×100 mm) on the machine table and secure it with clamps and side set screws. Use a tooling ball offset 10 mm from Datum Point 1 to set the workpiece origin. Clamp the 100×100×5 mm acrylic blank flat on the fixture plate with top clamps. Upload and select the program: 59_1_F3.175T1F1.5T3F1T4V3.175T6E0.3T7. Start the machining task and wait for the machine to finish this operation.

data.name: 59_1_F3.175T1F2T2F1.5T3F1T4F0.8T5V3.175T6E0.3T7M2T8
data.description: Mount the workpiece following the video tutorial: flip over the part from Process 1 and secure it with locating pins. To avoid cutting through the part, set the fixture plate top as Z0 and raise the tool by one blank thickness (5 mm). Upload and select the program: 59_1_F3.175T1F2T2F1.5T3F1T4F0.8T5V3.175T6E0.3T7M2T8. Start the machining task and wait for the machine to finish this operation.
